name: app.R
content:
#
# This is a Shiny web application. You can run the application by clicking
# the 'Run App' button above.
#
# Find out more about building applications with Shiny here:
#
#    https://shiny.posit.co/
#

library(shiny)

# Helper function to generate a collaborator row
collaborator_row <- function(name, institution) {
  div(style = "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8e8;",
      span(style = "font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;", name),
      span(style = "font-size: 13px; color: #888;", institution)
  )
}

ui <- fluidPage(
  
  tabsetPanel(
    
    tabPanel("Overview",
             br(),
             
             # Hero
             div(style = "padding-bottom: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e0e0; margin-bottom: 2rem;",
                 p("Social Science Text Data Initiative", style = "font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: #888; margin-bottom: .5rem;"),
                 h1("AI-DG — Avoid Inefficient Data Generation", style = "font-size: 26px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: .75rem;"),
                 p("A network of scholars collecting or planning to collect social science text data, working together to avoid unnecessary and inefficient duplication and build better datasets.",
                   style = "font-size: 15px; color: #555; max-width: 580px; line-height: 1.7;")
             ),
             
             # Why section
             h5("WHY AI-DG", style = "font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #888; margin-bottom: 1rem;"),
             fluidRow(
               column(4, div(style = "border: 1px solid #e8e8e8; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 12px; height: 100%;",
                             h6("Avoid unnecessary and inefficient duplication", style = "font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: .3rem;"),
                             p("Many datasets are developed in isolation, often simultaneously, wasting resources on parallel efforts.",
                               style = "font-size: 13px; color: #666; margin: 0;")
               )),
               column(4, div(style = "border: 1px solid #e8e8e8; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 12px; height: 100%;",
                             h6("Enable collaboration", style = "font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: .3rem;"),
                             p("Early coordination helps identify synergies, share resources, and exchange knowledge.",
                               style = "font-size: 13px; color: #666; margin: 0;")
               )),
               column(4, div(style = "border: 1px solid #e8e8e8; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 12px; height: 100%;",
                             h6("Common standards", style = "font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: .3rem;"),
                             p("Identify gaps and develop shared metadata standards across projects and research groups.",
                               style = "font-size: 13px; color: #666; margin: 0;")
               ))
             ),
             br(),
             
             # What we provide
             h5("WHAT WE PROVIDE", style = "font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #888; margin-bottom: 1rem;"),
             div(style = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;",
                 div(style = "display: flex; gap: 12px;",
                     div(style = "width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:50%; background:#f0f0f0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:#666; flex-shrink:0;", "1"),
                     div(h6("Researcher network", style = "margin-bottom:3px; font-weight:500;"),
                         p("A large network supported by an AI-powered search tool to connect researchers working on similar data collection projects.", style = "font-size:13px; color:#666; margin:0;"))
                 ),
                 div(style = "display: flex; gap: 12px;",
                     div(style = "width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:50%; background:#f0f0f0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:#666; flex-shrink:0;", "2"),
                     div(h6("Dataset overview", style = "margin-bottom:3px; font-weight:500;"),
                         p("An overview that surveys existing text datasets and those currently under development.", style = "font-size:13px; color:#666; margin:0;"))
                 ),
                 div(style = "display: flex; gap: 12px;",
                     div(style = "width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:50%; background:#f0f0f0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:#666; flex-shrink:0;", "3"),
                     div(h6("Regular updates", style = "margin-bottom:3px; font-weight:500;"),
                         p("Updates on ongoing social science text data projects and newly released datasets relevant to the community, with the opportunity to participate for joint effort.", style = "font-size:13px; color:#666; margin:0;"))
                 )
             ),
             br(),
             
             # Join box
             h5("JOIN AI-DG", style = "font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #888; margin-bottom: 1rem;"),
             div(style = "background: #f8f8f6; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem;",
                 div(
                   h6("Become a collaborator", style = "font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 4px;"),
                   p("As we present AI-DG to the broader research community, you are welcome to join as an official collaborator. Below you can find a list with all the researchers who have already joined as official collaborators.",
                     style = "font-size: 13px; color: #666; margin: 0;")
                 ),
                 div(style = "display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;",
                     tags$a(href = "mailto:Leonce.Roeth@gsi.uni-muenchen.de",
                            style = "background: white; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit;",
                            "✉ Leonce"
                     ),
                     tags$a(href = "mailto:luck@soz.uni-frankfurt.de",
                            style = "background: white; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit;",
                            "✉ Simon"
                     )
                 )
             ),
             br(),
             
             # List of collaborators
             h5("COLLABORATORS", style = "font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #888; margin-bottom: 1rem;"),
             div(style = "display: flex; flex-direction: column;",
                 collaborator_row("Jakob Berg", "University of Regensburg"),
                 collaborator_row("Matthias Brunn", "EUI"),
                 collaborator_row("Paride Carrara", "University of Latvia/University of Milan"),
                 collaborator_row("Joshua Cova", "Max Planck Institute for the Study of Societies"),
                 collaborator_row("Simon Franzmann", "University of Göttingen"),
                 collaborator_row("Julian Garritzmann", "Goethe University Frankfurt"),
                 collaborator_row("Daniela Grunow", "Goethe University Frankfurt"),
                 collaborator_row("Christoph Ivanusch", "LMU Munich"),
                 collaborator_row("Malo Jan", "Science Po Paris"),
                 collaborator_row("Pola Lehman", "Social Science Center Berlin"),
                 collaborator_row("Christian Rauh", "Social Science Center Berlin/University of Potsdam"),
                 collaborator_row("Ingo Rohlfing", "University of Passau"),
                 collaborator_row("Nelson Santos", "Université de Namur"),
                 collaborator_row("Luis Sattelmayer", "Science Po Paris"),
                 collaborator_row("Lucas Schramm", "LMU Munich"),
                 collaborator_row("Jan Schwalbach", "GESIS"),
                 collaborator_row("Michele Scotto di Vettimo", "Kings College London"),
                 collaborator_row("Miklós Sebők", "poltextLAB"),
                 collaborator_row("Sophie Suda", "University of Basel"),
                 collaborator_row("Aidar Zinnatullin", "RPTU University Kaiserslautern-Landau")
             ),
             br(),
             
             # Imprint
             h5("IMPRINT", style = "font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #888; margin-bottom: 1rem;"),
             div(style = "font-size: 13px; color: #666; line-height: 1.8;",
                 p("Simon Luck (Goethe-University Frankfurt)"),
                 p("Theodor-W.-Adorno-Platz 6"),
                 p("60323 Frankfurt am Main"),
                 p("Germany"),
                 br(),
                 p("Phone: +49 (0)69 798-36590"),
                 p(tags$a(href = "mailto:luck@soz.uni-frankfurt.de", "luck@soz.uni-frankfurt.de")),
                 p("Responsible according to § 55 para. 2 RStV: Simon Luck")
             ),
    
     # Logos
     div(style = "display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin-top: 4rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; padding-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0;",
         tags$img(src = "goethe.svg.png", height = "60px"),
         tags$img(src = "infer.png", height = "60px"),
         tags$img(src = "lmu.svg.png", height = "60px"),
         tags$img(src = "erc.jpg", height = "60px")
     )
                      
    ), 
    
    tabPanel("Data Portal",
             h1("Data Overview"),
             tags$iframe(
               src = "corpus_coverage_explorer.html",
               width = "100%",
               height = "800px",
               style = "border: none;"
             )
    )
    
  ) 
) 

# Define server logic required to draw a histogram
server <- function(input, output) {}

# Run the application 
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
